title: Diagonal Traverse
description:
Given an `m x n` integer matrix `mat`, return an array of all elements of `mat` in diagonal zig-zag order.

Start at `(0, 0)` and traverse diagonals in increasing order of `d = r + c` from `0` to `m + n - 2`: even-indexed diagonals (`d % 2 == 0`) move upward-right (row decreases, column increases), while odd-indexed diagonals (`d % 2 == 1`) move downward-left (row increases, column decreases).
hints: Every cell on the same anti-diagonal shares the same sum r + c.
When moving up-right and hitting a boundary, check the right boundary (c == n - 1) before the top boundary (r == 0) so the top-right corner moves down rather than out of bounds.
Symmetrically, when moving down-left and hitting a boundary, check the bottom boundary (r == m - 1) before the left boundary (c == 0) so the bottom-left corner moves right.
